A beautiful, dark- haired lady, a concert pianist, my stepmother, whose studio was next to my  room. I had intractable pain at particular times. This was her way of helping me get through the beginnings. A lullaby for a child she did not bear and for the child within she was told could never come.
With only the light above the sheet music into the night. The loving way she played and graced the bench in satin  flowing to the floor.
So gently, her long fingers floated across the keys, 
she'd play into the night, as long as it took, for a young woman in pain to drift off to sleep, in merciful rest.
This is something I must share with her while I can. And share with her only child because she would not remember these times, though she was right there🥲🎼🎹🎶

What a blessing for God to interject her into your life when you needed it.  She shall love to hear about the peace she was able to bring you.  For some, the brain no longer stores those memories because they are in fact, stored within our hearts instead.  She sounds remarkable.

A beautiful, dark- haired lady, a concert pianist, my stepmother, whose studio was next to my  room. I had intractable pain at particular times. This was her way of helping me get through the beginnings. A lullaby for a child she did not bear and for the child within she was told could never come.
With only the light above the sheet music into the night. The loving way she played and graced the bench in satin  flowing to the floor.
So gently, her long fingers floated across the keys, 
she'd play into the night, as long as it took, for a young woman in pain to drift off to sleep, in merciful rest.
This is something I must share with her while I can. And share with her only child because she would not remember these times, though she was right there🥲🎼🎹🎶

What a blessing for God to interject her into your life when you needed it.  She shall love to hear about the peace she was able to bring you.  For some, the brain no longer stores those memories because they are in fact, stored within our hearts instead.  She sounds remarkable.
